title: The Pokémon That Needs 999 Coins to Evolve
premise: Pokédex #999 evolves only after you collect 999 Gimmighoul Coins and level it up.
audiencePromise: Reveal Gimmighoul's 999-coin evolution, then pay it off by landing on Pokémon #1000.
openLoop: Why does Pokémon #999 need exactly 999 coins?
payoff: The 999-coin requirement turns Gimmighoul into Gholdengo, Pokédex #1000.
engagementQuestion: Is 999 coins a brilliant evolution gimmick or just too much work?

voice.instructions: Fast, playful, curious short-form narrator. Sound like a knowledgeable Pokémon fan sharing a bizarre mechanic with a friend. Punch the words 999 and 1000. Keep the delivery energetic but natural, with tiny pauses before each reveal. Never imitate a known person or character.

scenes.headline: 999 COINS. ONE EVOLUTION.
scenes.narration: This Pokémon needs nine hundred ninety-nine coins to evolve.
scenes.caption: 999 COINS TO EVOLVE

scenes.headline: A GHOST IN A TREASURE CHEST
scenes.narration: Meet Gimmighoul: Ghost-type, number nine hundred ninety-nine, hiding in a treasure chest.
scenes.caption: A GHOST. IN A CHEST.

scenes.headline: NO STONE. NO TRADE.
scenes.narration: No evolution stone. No trade. No fixed evolution level.
scenes.caption: NO STONE • NO TRADE

scenes.headline: COLLECT 999 GIMMIGHOUL COINS
scenes.narration: Collect coins until you hit nine hundred ninety-nine. Then level Gimmighoul up.
scenes.caption: COLLECT 999 COINS

scenes.headline: #999 BECOMES #1000
scenes.narration: That turns number nine hundred ninety-nine into Gholdengo: Pokémon one thousand.

scenes.headline: BRILLIANT OR TOO MUCH?
scenes.narration: Brilliant gimmick—or way too much work?
scenes.caption: BRILLIANT OR RIDICULOUS?
